detail: M3 indexer config (topk 16, one local block): one probe request scored at batch slot 0 under co-batches of 2 and 8. The scorer sizes split-K as 512/batch, so the probe is cut into 256 chunks in one composition and 64 in the other; its scores and its selected blocks must still match bit-for-bit, because those scores choose which blocks attention reads.
